serving: Vite preview with configFile:false for both artifact directories; default gzip compression; same local API 503 middleware.
isolation: Fresh browser context per trial; serviceWorkers:block; CDP cache disabled; all non-selected-origin requests aborted; no room entered.
limitations: Local Chromium CDP simulation on one Windows PC, not physical low-end hardware or a field SLO.
API requests return 503 and external requests are blocked; this isolates startup and does not measure successful authentication, network room entry, sharing startup, or playback.
Vite preview gzip uses zlib default compression; transfer graph comparison uses the repository helper with deterministic level-9 gzip.
Bootstrap ready is recorded by MutationObserver when the 51-step dataset reaches ready. LCP is a snapshot shortly after the first paint, not final session LCP.
Five trials per variant do not establish statistical significance or prove future budget growth is neutral.

testExecution.assertionScope: 10 cold navigations: ready, exactly 51 steps, zero failures/fallbacks/pageErrors, real gzip JS and CSS response headers, no Service Worker controller

harnessPreparation: An optional Network.setAcceptedEncodings CDP command was unsupported by this Chromium and removed before any measured navigation. Both previews use Vite default gzip and every recorded trial verifies actual JS/CSS Content-Encoding response headers.
